dataset: Severson processed feature profiles; 41 train cells, 43 fixed test1 cells
operating_condition_proxy: KMeans clusters of standardized cell-mean 99D profiles; no explicit temperature/chemistry metadata used
design: same N=12 cells and S=12 temporal feature segments (one first window per cell); diverse=6 per each of 2 clusters; homogeneous=12 from largest cluster
limitations: Feature-space clusters are only a surrogate for condition diversity, not known temperature/current/load metadata. All data are one LFP laboratory family; this cannot establish generalization to unseen operating conditions. One fixed draw per design makes this descriptive pilot, not a significance test.
